text:
When aqueous iodine is added to a solution of vanadium ions, V2+, the V2+ ions each lose one
electron.
Which property of transition elements is shown by this reaction?
A
Transition elements have variable oxidation states.
B
Transition elements form a stable 1+ ion.
C
Transition elements are oxidising agents.
D
Transition elements can act as catalysts.

options.label: A
options.text: Transition elements have variable oxidation states.

options.label: B
options.text: Transition elements form a stable 1+ ion.

options.label: D
options.text: Transition elements can act as catalysts.
